source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Air Injection Reactor System, p.6T-1

procedures.title: Air Injection Reactor (A.I.R.) system: description
steps: Know the parts: belt-driven air injection pump with brackets, one injection tube per cylinder, a diverter valve, check valves (2 on V8s), and the air manifolds, tubes and hoses connecting them (see figure 1 in the manual).
Never swap the special carburetor or distributor of an A.I.R. engine for one made for an engine without A.I.R.
notes: The pump (with built-in filter) pushes air through the manifolds and tubes into the exhaust near the exhaust valves, where it burns unburned exhaust gas.
The diverter valve cuts off injected air when manifold vacuum rises sharply (see figure 3 in the manual).
